Reach New Heights: Aerospace Engineering at USF
Fall 2025 marked a major milestone for USF with the introduction of new Aerospace
Engineering degree programs at the bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral levels. Take
flight with USF. Explore the Aerospace Engineering programs and be part of the next
generation driving the future of air and space.

In The News
Dr. Nathan Gallant Featured in USF Defense Research Collaboration
Dr. Gallant’s research is part of USF’s expanding partnership with the U.S. Army,
supporting defense-related health research.
Dr. Ajit Mujumdar and Dr. Brett Freidkes Honored for Teaching Excellence
Their recognition highlights the department’s impact in the classroom, with undergraduate
teaching and service helping shape the next generation of engineers.
Dr. Arman Sargolzaei Receives Outstanding Research Achievement Award
The recognition reflects ongoing work in autonomous and networked systems, with research
aimed at advancing safer, more reliable transportation and infrastructure.
